summary: Full backend + frontend testing for BroDo Expo e-commerce app. 8/8 backend pytest tests PASS. All 12 frontend flows validated on mobile viewport (390x844) including home render, category filter, cart badges, product detail nav, cart CRUD, and Stripe checkout redirect.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RN Web deprecation, non-blocking, coming from a library.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan for future-proofing (non-blocking).

checkout success_url points to /api/checkout/success which auto-marks order paid on GET without any Stripe verification — anyone with the order_id could hit it and mark order paid. For production, verify session status via Stripe API or use webhook. Acceptable for demo with Emergent test key.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend auto-seeds 8 products on startup if products collection is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://style-commerce-app-5.preview.emergentagent.com). Product IDs used in tests: ace-nova-dark-brown (sneakers, $49), runner-onyx (sneakers, $56), milan-penny-loafer (loafers, $72). Stripe checkout via emergentintegrations returns a real checkout.stripe.com URL — DO NOT complete payment. Bottom tabs are labeled 'Shop', 'Cart', 'Menu'. testIDs are well-covered (see grep in /app/frontend/app).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. Verified backend endpoints match spec: GET /api/products (8 items), category filter, GET /api/products/{id} with 404 on unknown, POST /api/checkout/session returns {order_id, checkout_url, session_id} and returns 400 for unknown product_id, 422 for empty items. Frontend: header cart badge and bottom-tab Cart badge both correctly reflect CartContext count (verified 1 then 2). Category pill 'sneakers' correctly filters grid (boots card not in DOM). Cart increment updates subtotal ($177 -> $226 for $49 sneaker). Stripe redirect confirmed — page.context ended with URL checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_....
